simpleoptimization.guide.page.1.title: Simple Optimization
simpleoptimization.guide.page.1: Bundles Simple Opt Render, Simple Opt Memory and Simple Opt Server with one switch each. Each has its own chapter here.
simpleoptimization.guide.page.2.title: Super-mod for optimizations
simpleoptimization.guide.page.2: Simple Optimization has no content of its own: it bundles Simple Opt Render, Simple Opt Memory and Simple Opt Server.
simpleoptimization.guide.page.3.title: Super-mod for optimizations
simpleoptimization.guide.page.3: config/simpleoptimization.json holds one switch each (enableSimpleOptRender, enableSimpleOptMemory, enableSimpleOptServer, default true);
simpleoptimization.guide.page.4.title: Super-mod for optimizations
simpleoptimization.guide.page.4: off makes that sub-mod inert, its own settings stay in its own config. Every sub-mod also runs alone; a server only needs Simple Opt Server.
simpleoptimization.guide.page.5.title: Commands
simpleoptimization.guide.page.5: /simpleoptimization config shows and changes every option of config/simpleoptimization.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleoptimization.guide.page.6.title: Commands
simpleoptimization.guide.page.6: The file is read once while the game starts, so a change is saved at once but takes effect after a restart (each answer says so). Permission level 2.
